studyPolicy.description: Roads are ranked from most to least important: primary, then secondary, tertiary, unclassified, and residential or living-street roads; within a class, longer mapped roads rank higher, and equal lengths are ordered by name. The rank is the card order.
rankedBy: road class (primary, secondary, tertiary, unclassified, residential/living street)

provenance.geometry: OSM way geometry clipped to study bounds and descriptive study rectangles, with continuous street polylines reconnected across sub-90m area corners, colinear unnamed road segments, shared highway concurrencies, and short cross-street doglegs; lengths measured on a sphere with mean Earth radius 6371008.8 m.
